articles.title: Trump says he has rejected Iranian proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Despite Trump’s comments, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said no rejection had come through official channels.

articles.title: Trump rejects Iran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Saturday rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week if the U.S. meets certain conditions.

articles.title: Trump says he rejected the latest Iranian proposal
articles.description: President Trump said on Saturday that he rejected the latest Iranian proposal that was conveyed to the U.S. during indirect negotiations in New York this week. articles.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian talks about proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
articles.description: Iran's Masoud Pezeshkian, who is also a physician, says he has visited Iran's supreme leader twice and talked with CBS News' Margaret Brennan about Mojtaba Khamenei's health.

topics.summary: Trump said he rejected Iran’s proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week if the United States met certain conditions. Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said no rejection had been conveyed through official channels.
